example_summary: A Ltd. issued debentures worth 3.50 crores to IFCI Ltd. on 31.3.2026 in lieu of unpaid interest and claimed deduction for A.Y.2026-27.
source_provision:
| Statutory Provision / Explanation | Core Applicability & Threshold | Mandatory Tax Treatment & Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Section 43B Main Provision** | Sums payable by way of interest on any loan or borrowing from a public financial institution. | Allowed as deduction strictly in the previous year in which such sum is **actually paid** by the assessee. |
| **Section 43B Proviso** | Sums paid on or before the due date of filing return of income under **Section 139(1)**. | Allowed as deduction if actual payment is completed prior to the specified return filing deadline. |
| **Section 43B Explanation 3C** | Interest payable converted into a loan, borrowing, advance, or debenture deferred to a future date. | Conversion into debentures or new borrowings **shall not be deemed as actual payment**, disallowing the deduction. |


> [!IMPORTANT]
> Legislative Intent of Explanation 3C: The statutory insertion of Explanation 3C ensures that mere book entries substituting unpaid interest liabilities with structured debt instruments (like debentures) do not bypass the cash-flow realization requirement mandated under Section 43B.


> [!WARNING]
> Assessing Officer Authority: If an assessee claims a business deduction for interest converted into debentures without cash outflow, the Assessing Officer is statutorily bound to reject the deduction under Section 43B read with Explanation 3C.

director.justification: The case tests whether the conversion of unpaid interest into debentures overrides the general deduction rule under Section 43B via Explanation 3C.
director.visual_metaphor: A ledger balance sheet where paper debentures are weighed against physical cash outflow, showing that paper replacement fails the cash payment test.

beat_plan.beat_goal: Establish A Ltd. owing interest to IFCI Ltd. and issuing debentures on 31.3.2026.
Explain the general rule under Section 43B requiring actual payment for interest deduction.
Examine the proviso regarding payment on or before the due date under Section 139(1).
Analyze Explanation 3C regarding the conversion of interest into debentures.
Conclude on the validity of the Assessing Officer's action rejecting the deduction.
